profiles.details:
Sources and context

A lab reference and an hs-CRP risk category answer different questions.

This example uses The Valley Hospital’s published hs-CRP reference below 3 mg/L. Laboratory limits may differ.

The AHA describes relative cardiovascular-risk categories based on hs-CRP: lower below 1 mg/L, average from 1 to 3 mg/L, and higher above 3 mg/L. These categories do not determine your overall risk or set a treatment target.

Illness, infection or injury can raise hs-CRP. A single measurement does not establish whether an elevation persists.

THE EVIDENCE

Lab reference: Valley Hospital
hs-CRP categories: AHA
Prospective evidence: ERFC
Understand the difference

El mismo ejemplo de 2,9 está dentro de la referencia del laboratorio y fuera de la categoría de menor riesgo. Esta categoría no indica tu riesgo global ni es un objetivo óptimo universal.
